_help: Edit leagues to override tie-break order by league ID, or league ID plus :season name; supported rules: points, goalDifference, goalsFor, headToHeadPoints, headToHeadGoalDifference, headToHeadGoalsFor, fairPlayPoints. Use points to override win/draw/loss points and excludedStages to omit non-table phases by exact stage name. Restart the server after changes.
